dct_description_sm: The purpose of this study was to create an adaptation plan in-line with the community's values, by evaluating the vulnerabilities of the social, ecological and economic systems. The first year of the project focused mostly on assessing the community vulnerabilities. In the second year, the adaptation plan was developed based on results from year one and other planning initiatives such as land use and economic, and community planning.
